messages.subject: 2025 Houlihan Lokey Summer Analyst Program
messages.body:
Hi Jonathan,

I hope you're well! By way of introduction, my name is Lynell Velten and I lead Corporate Finance Campus Recruiting at Houlihan Lokey. I received your resume from our Consumer Retail team in LA and we appreciate your interest in our internship program. In order to be considered, please submit a formal application on our HL Careers Website.

Any questions, please don't hesitate to reach out.

Best,
Lynell

Lynell Velten, Vice President, CF Campus Recruiting

messages.subject: Re: 2025 Houlihan Lokey Summer Analyst Program
messages.body:
Hi Lynell,

I hope you are doing well. I submitted my formal application online yesterday for Houlihan Lokey’s 2025 Summer Financial Analyst (Class of 2026) - Corporate Finance, Los Angeles Consumer, Food & Retail position. I have not yet completed my virtual Suited assessment yet. I am wondering if that is the reason you are not able to see my application. If you could provide some clarification that would be much appreciated.

Best,
Jonathan

messages.subject: RE: 2025 Houlihan Lokey Summer Analyst Program
messages.body:
Hi Jonathan,

My apologies, I was searching on your gmail address in our applicant tracking system and for some reason your application did not appear. I researched on your name and I was able to locate it. Please disregard my previous email!

Best,
